execute.description: Copy non-env personal secrets into UserHarnessSecret, skipping local-only prefixes
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "public"."UserHarnessSecret" ("id","userId","name","sealedValue","createdAt","updatedAt")
SELECT "id","userId","name","sealedValue","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "public"."SecretEntry"
WHERE "name" !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,199}$' AND "name" NOT LIKE 'sandbox-serve:%' AND "name" NOT LIKE 'mcp-oauth:%'
